objective: Certify P3 independently by joining P2 with the exact selected production SRE, recovery, security, current-capability, and claim-evidence records; P3_PRODUCTION_INTEGRATED_PROFILE_GATE_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: P3 is inferred from P1/P2 or certified from prose placeholders rather than selected required-now records and retained production evidence.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

required_work: Freeze and join the exact selected production integration gates before certification.
out_of_scope: all conditional future profiles by default
positive_proof: The selected production profile passes its frozen SRE, recovery, security, and claim-evidence thresholds.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Missing selected gate, stale currentness, recovery failure, or claim drift blocks certification.

external_gates.condition: Exact SRE/security/recovery thresholds and cohort are frozen before observation.

remaining_nonclaims: P3 does not activate every conditional profile.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Reopen P3 on any selected production gate regression.
